summary.content:
Today's selection covers 93 articles from 8 trusted sources, including 63 on Artificial Intelligence and 16 on Fraud/Cybersecurity.

• **AI Spotlight**: Claude Model Builds Exploits Across Major Browsers & OSes
• **Companies in Focus**: Coverage includes developments from OpenAI, Google, Anthropic
• **Security Alert**: Anthropic is asking Wall Street to believe in AGI
• **Threat Landscape**: Today's coverage highlights ransomware, phishing, data breaches
• **Source Diversity**: Articles sourced from Dark Reading, The Verge, TechCrunch, SecurityWeek, BleepingComputer and others
• **Fresh Content**: 56 articles published in the last 24 hours
